trajectory_summary: The call opens on a skeptical, business-model-probing customer and never recovers: the rep skips the interest question, gets pulled into three rounds of financial-mechanism explanation, and only redirects to the specialist after the customer has already begun disengaging. Energy leaked steadily from mild skepticism to explicit refusal, with no anchor (bill, reason-use, or curiosity hook) ever deployed to arrest the slide.
